scenes.text: Have you ever felt a sudden chill, a wave of dread, or even seen a shadow move out of the corner of your eye in an empty room?
You might think your house is haunted, but the real culprit could be a sound you can’t even hear.
This precise frequency is known as the ghost frequency because it matches the natural resonant frequency of the human eyeball.
It also triggers a primal fear response in your brain, causing intense dread and goosebumps.
